errors.evidence: The chart displays three data series (Accuracy, Confidence, Alignment), not four.

errors.text_span: Тя започва при стойност от 0.88 и спада до 0.20 по оста Y.
errors.evidence: The blue line (Accuracy) starts at a value of approximately 0.08, not 0.88. It also doesn't just drop; it dips, rises to a peak around x=210, and then drops to a final value of about 0.26.

errors.text_span: започва на 0, достатъчно близо до стойност 300 на оста X
errors.evidence: This phrase is confusing and poorly structured. The line starts at an x-value close to 0 (around 10) and ends near 300 (at 290). The description seems to conflate the start and end of the x-axis range.
In the paragraph describing the green line (Confidence), it is stated to have round markers, but the figure shows it has triangle markers.
The green line (Confidence) starts at a value of approximately 0.58, not 0.82.
In the paragraph describing the red line (Alignment), it is stated to have round markers, but the figure shows it has square markers.

errors.text_span: Тя започва при стойност от 0.64 и спада до 0.48 по оста Y.
errors.evidence: The red line (Alignment) starts at approximately 0.50 (not 0.64) and ends at approximately 0.65 (not 0.48). It does not simply drop; it dips, rises to a peak of ~0.78, and then falls.

errors.text_span: Линията, оцветена в синьо, представлява популярността на отговорите, маркирана с кръгли маркери. Тя започва при стойност от 0.36 и започва да се увеличава до 0.84 по оста Y. Линията е плътна и започва на 0, достатъчно близо до стойност 300 на оста X.
errors.evidence: This entire paragraph is hallucinated. It describes a non-existent fourth data series, incorrectly claiming the blue line represents 'answer popularity' (which is the x-axis label) and provides incorrect numerical values that do not correspond to any line on the chart.

errors.text_span: Линията е плътна и започва на 0, достатъчно близо до стойност 300 на оста X.
errors.evidence: The same confusing and poorly structured sentence is repeated four times across the description, adding no value and reducing readability.
The y-axis major ticks are spaced every 0.2 units (0.0, 0.2, 0.4, etc.), not 0.1 units.
